visual_review: Side-view helmet facing right, read at 48px and 384px in both themes: a new face guard bar leaves the straight jaw, runs out to the right edge, drops and returns along the bottom as in the reference; the ear detail is now a hollow ring moved from (16,27) to (18,28).
omissions: Ear ring is r3 (the smallest hole the gate accepts), since the shell bottom at y40 limits how low a larger ring can sit.
lucide_reference: No useful Lucide match; shell built from two cubics with a straight jaw.
feedback: redraw the face guard, and move the circular detail down and slightly right while making it hollow.
